title: Clearing a tape from a configuration
statement: Let $i<k$, let $w$ be a word over an alphabet, and let $d$ be a configuration in the sweep state. Suppose that for every integer $p$ with $-1\le p\le |w|$, tape $i$ at position $d_i+p$ contains the symbol of $w$ at position $p$ when that position is in the word, and is blank otherwise. After $2|w|+2$ steps, the clearing machine is in the done state, with tape $i$ blank on $[d_i,d_i+|w|)$ and all other tape cells unchanged; it was not in the done state at any earlier time. Throughout those steps, the head on tape $i$ stays in $[d_i-1,d_i+|w|]$, while every other tape head stays at its initial position.
hypotheses_covered: starting configuration $d$ is in sweep state
tape contents on tape $i$ match the buffered word for all $-1\le p\le |w|$
all tape indices and times through endpoint
